subject: Christian Religious Studies
examFormat: Papers 1 and 2 are taken at one sitting as a composite paper. Paper 1 has fifty multiple-choice objective questions, all to be answered in 1 hour for 40 marks. Paper 2 has nine essay-type questions (Section A Old Testament four, Section B Synoptic Gospels and Acts three, Section C Epistles two); candidates answer four in 2 hours for 60 marks, choosing at least one from each section and the fourth from Section A or B. The Revised Standard Version of the Bible is used.

The Trials of Jesus

topics.name: The Epistle of James

topics.name: The Epistle of 1 Peter
topics.content: Passages: Good Citizenship - 1 Peter 2:13-17. Christians living among non-Christians - 1 Peter 2:1-25. Interpersonal relationship among Christians - 1 Peter 5:1-11.
